title: Detecting Inappropriate Messages on Sensitive Topics that Could Harm a Company’s Reputation

bias_targets.methodology: Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify 'racism and ethnicism' and label the appropriateness of the messages, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify 'sexism' and gender stereotypes, labeling the appropriateness of the messages, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify discussions regarding 'sexual minorities' and label their appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.
Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify discussions of 'religion' and label their appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify discussions of 'politics' and military conflicts, labeling their appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify 'health shaming' (physical and mental disorders, disabilities) and label its appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify 'body shaming' (people's appearances and clothes) and label its appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.

Crowdsourced annotation of a Russian text dataset to identify discussions of 'social injustice, inequality, and class society' and label their appropriateness, followed by training and evaluating a BERT-based classification model.
